units.Zechariah 6:14: The crown will be for those who endure, for its useful people and those who have known it, for the favor of Zephaniah’s son and for a psalm in the Lord’s house.
units.Zechariah 9:12: You will settle in a stronghold, prisoners of the gathering; in exchange for one day of your sojourn I will repay you double.
units.Zechariah 12:7: The Lord will save Judah’s dwellings as from the beginning, so that the boasting of David’s house and Jerusalem’s residents’ exaltation will not magnify itself over Judah.
units.Zechariah 12:11: On that day mourning in Jerusalem will grow great, like mourning over a pomegranate grove cut down in a plain,
units.Zechariah 6:10: “Take the things from the captivity, from its rulers, from its useful people and from those who have known it; you shall go that day into the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah, who has come from Babylon,
units.Zechariah 6:11: take silver and gold, make crowns and put them on the head of Joshua son of Josedek, the high priest,
units.Zechariah 6:12: and say to him: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Look, a man whose name is Rising! From beneath him he will rise, and he will build the Lord’s house.
units.Zechariah 6:13: He himself will receive excellence, sit and rule on his throne; the priest will be at his right hand, and peaceful counsel will be between both.
units.Zechariah 6:15: Those far away from them will come and build in the Lord’s house, and you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you truly listen to the voice of the Lord your God.”
units.James 1:9: Let the lowly brother boast in his exaltation,
units.James 1:10: and the rich person in his humiliation, because he will pass away like a flower of grass.
units.James 1:11: For the sun rose with its scorching heat and dried the grass, and its flower fell, and the beauty of its appearance perished. So also the rich person will wither in his pursuits.
units.James 1:12: Blessed is the man who endures a trial, because, having been approved, he will receive the crown of life that He promised to those who love Him.
units.James 1:13: Let no one who is tempted say, “I am being tempted by God.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, and He Himself tempts no one.
units.James 1:14: But each person is tempted when drawn away and enticed by his own desire.
units.James 1:15: Then desire, after conceiving, gives birth to sin; and sin, when fully grown, gives birth to death.
units.Zechariah 9:11: You, by covenant blood, released your prisoners from a pit with no water.
units.Zechariah 9:13: For I bent you, Judah, as a bow for Myself; I filled Ephraim, and I will rouse your children, Zion, against the Greeks’ children and handle you like a fighter’s sword.
units.Job 42:7: After the Lord had spoken all these words to Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “You and your two friends sinned, for you spoke nothing true before Me, as My servant Job did.
units.Job 42:8: Now take seven calves and seven rams and go to My servant Job, and he will make an offering on your behalf. My servant Job will pray for you, for I will surely accept his person. Were it not for him, I would have destroyed you; for you did not speak truth against My servant Job.”
units.Job 42:9: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Minaean went and did as the Lord commanded them, and He released their sin through Job.
units.Job 42:10: The Lord increased Job. When he also prayed for his friends, He forgave their sin. The Lord gave double what Job had formerly, for a doubling.
units.Job 42:11: All his brothers and sisters heard everything that had happened to him and came to him, along with all who had known him from the beginning. They ate and drank with him and consoled him, and marveled at all the Lord had brought upon him. Each gave him one ewe lamb and an unstamped gold piece of four drachmas.
units.Job 42:12: The Lord blessed Job’s latter things more than the former. His livestock were fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen and one thousand grazing female donkeys.
units.Zechariah 12:5: Judah’s commanders of thousands will say in their hearts, ‘We will find for ourselves Jerusalem’s residents in the Lord Almighty, their God.’
units.Zechariah 12:6: On that day I will make Judah’s commanders of thousands like a firebrand among wood and a flaming torch among stalks. They will consume all the surrounding peoples to right and left, and Jerusalem will again dwell by herself.
units.Zechariah 12:8: On that day the Lord will shield Jerusalem’s residents. The weak among them will be like David’s house on that day, and David’s house like God’s house, like the angel of the Lord before them.
units.Zechariah 12:9: On that day I will seek to remove all the nations coming against Jerusalem.
units.Zechariah 12:10: I will pour upon David’s house and Jerusalem’s residents a spirit of grace and compassion. They will look toward Me because they danced in mockery, and mourn over him as over a beloved one; they will suffer grief as over a firstborn.
units.1 Corinthians 4:1: This is how a person should regard us: as servants of Christ and stewards of God’s mysteries.
units.1 Corinthians 4:2: Moreover, what is required of stewards is that each be found faithful.
units.1 Corinthians 4:3: But to me it is a very small matter that I should be examined by you or by a human court; indeed, I do not even examine myself.
units.1 Corinthians 4:4: For I am aware of nothing against myself, but I am not thereby justified. The One who examines me is the Lord.
units.1 Corinthians 4:5: So judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes. He will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the purposes of hearts; then each one’s praise will come from God.
units.1 Corinthians 4:6: Now, brothers, I have applied these things figuratively to myself and Apollos for your sake, so that in us you may learn, “Not beyond what is written,” so that none of you may be puffed up in favor of one against another.
units.1 Corinthians 4:7: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you did not receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you had not received it?
units.Zechariah 12:12: and the land will mourn tribe by tribe, each tribe by itself and their wives by themselves: the tribe of David’s house by itself and their wives by themselves; the tribe of Nathan’s house by itself and their wives by themselves;
units.Zechariah 12:13: the tribe of Levi’s house by itself and their wives by themselves; the tribe of Simeon by itself and their wives by themselves;
units.Zechariah 12:14: all the tribes remaining, each tribe by itself and their wives by themselves.
units.Joel 1:9: Sacrifice and drink offering have been removed from the Lord’s house. Mourn, priests who minister at the altar,
units.Joel 1:10: because the plains have suffered. Let the earth mourn, because grain has suffered, wine has dried up, and oil has diminished.
units.Joel 1:11: The farmers have dried up. Lament, estates, over wheat and barley, because the harvest from the field has perished.
units.Joel 1:12: The vine has dried up and the fig trees have diminished; pomegranate, palm, apple tree and all the field’s trees have dried up, because human beings have put joy to shame.
units.Joel 1:13: Wrap yourselves and beat your breasts, priests; lament, ministers of the altar! Enter and sleep in sackcloth, ministers of God, because sacrifice and drink offering have been kept away from your God’s house.
units.1 Corinthians 1:1: Paul, called as an apostle of Christ Jesus through God’s will, and Sosthenes the brother,
units.1 Corinthians 1:2: to the Church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus, called as saints, together with all who call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, theirs and ours:
units.1 Corinthians 1:3: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.James 1:1: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes in the dispersion: greetings.
units.James 1:2: Count it all joy, my brothers, whenever you encounter trials of various kinds,
units.James 1:3: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
units.James 1:4: And let endurance have its complete work, so that you may be complete and whole, lacking in nothing.
